# Registers and conditions

Register names and condition names shared by ND-100, ND-110 and ND-120.

Source: [`defs/common/registers.yaml`](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/nd-microcode-meta/blob/main/defs/common/registers.yaml).

## Header of `registers.yaml`

```text
Common Register Name Definitions
Registers 0-17 (octal) are selected by the 4-bit A-OP and B-OP fields.
Names are shared across ND-100, ND-110, and ND-120.
```

## Registers

| index | octal | name | alt | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 0 | Z | ZERO | Zero register / status / scratch |
| 1 | 1 | D |  | D register (data) |
| 2 | 2 | P |  | P register (program counter) |
| 3 | 3 | B |  | B register (base) |
| 4 | 4 | L |  | L register (link) |
| 5 | 5 | A |  | A register (accumulator) |
| 6 | 6 | T |  | T register (temporary) |
| 7 | 7 | X |  | X register (index) |
| 8 | 10 | STS |  | Register 10 - status or scratch |
| 9 | 11 | R1 |  | Register 11 - address or scratch |
| 10 | 12 | R2 |  | Register 12 - scratch |
| 11 | 13 | R3 |  | Register 13 - scratch |
| 12 | 14 | R4 |  | Register 14 - scratch |
| 13 | 15 | R5 |  | Register 15 - scratch |
| 14 | 16 | R6 |  | Register 16 - scratch |
| 15 | 17 | R7 |  | Register 17 - scratch |

Source: [`defs/common/conditions.yaml`](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/nd-microcode-meta/blob/main/defs/common/conditions.yaml).

## Header of `conditions.yaml`

```text
Condition Code Definitions
Used when SCOND=1 to select which condition the microinstruction tests.
Values below encode the TSEL field (bits 7:4) and other associated bits.
```

## Conditions

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| STP | Stop / breakpoint condition |
| PXM | Prefix mode active |
| OVF | ALU Overflow |
| CRY | ALU Carry |
| F11 | Bit 11 of ALU result |
| F15 | Bit 15 of ALU result |
| F=0 | ALU result is all zeros |
| LC=0 | Loop counter equals zero |
| FETCH | Last memory request was fetch |
| IRQ | Interrupt request pending |
| RESTR | Restricted mode (ring 0-1) |
| OOD | One-out-detect flip-flop |
| DZD | Double-zero-detect flip-flop |
| COND | Outcome of the latest test (delays tests) |
